description: This file defines a React component 'ScheduleICU' used for scheduling ICU resource bookings. It interacts with APIs to load data, create bookings, and handle cancellations, and displays a UI with forms and schedules.

methods.name: ScheduleICU
methods.description: React functional component for scheduling ICU bookings with form inputs, data fetching, and schedule display.

methods.name: onBook
methods.description: Handles form submission to create a new booking via API and updates schedule list.

methods.name: onCancel
methods.description: Handles cancellation of a schedule entry via API and updates schedule list.
